description: Authoritative boundary-to-evidence inventory for the architecture characterization lanes.

rows.command: python tools/cargo_cache.py run -- cargo test -p stasis_compiler --test architecture_characterization -- --test-threads=1
rows.expected_evidence: One source produces equal semantic snapshots, canonical reachable symbols, patch reasons, stable layouts, JIT execution, normalized CLIF, AOT artifacts, and structurally parsed Wasm facts.

rows.command: python tools/cargo_cache.py run -- cargo test -p stasis_compiler --lib parser -- --test-threads=1
rows.expected_evidence: Parser tests accept valid syntax and reject malformed syntax with source context.

rows.command: python tools/cargo_cache.py run -- cargo test -p stasis_compiler --lib data_flow -- --test-threads=1
rows.expected_evidence: Data-flow summaries and effect contracts retain reads, writes, calls, and bounded-loop facts.

rows.command: python tools/cargo_cache.py run -- cargo test -p stasis_compiler --lib diagnostic -- --test-threads=1
rows.expected_evidence: Diagnostics preserve path, range, symbol, code, and deterministic message fields.

rows.command: python tools/cargo_cache.py run -- cargo test -p stasis_compiler --lib reachability -- --test-threads=1
rows.expected_evidence: Lifecycle roots and their dependencies are emitted while the unreferenced fixture function remains out of target artifacts.

rows.command: python tools/cargo_cache.py run -- cargo test -p stasis_compiler --lib patch -- --test-threads=1
rows.expected_evidence: Cold and edited plans freeze exact changed, re-JIT, reused, host-entry, and reason-chain sets.

rows.command: python tools/cargo_cache.py run -- cargo test -p stasis --lib rejected_between_tick_layout_migration_keeps_old_code_and_state -- --test-threads=1
rows.expected_evidence: A rejected edit leaves the previous executable code and state observable.

rows.command: python tools/cargo_cache.py run -- cargo test -p stasis_compiler --test host_frame_jit_seam -- --test-threads=1
rows.expected_evidence: Every HostFrame lane round-trips through compiled Stasis accessors and the render contract remains aligned.

rows.command: python tools/ci/verify_render_parity.py --profile portable
rows.expected_evidence: The portable render-parity fixture, command inventory, and declared regions are structurally valid.

rows.command: node --test runtime/web/tests/asset_paths.test.mjs
rows.expected_evidence: Packaged and fallback asset paths resolve to package-relative values without escaping the package.

rows.command: node --test runtime/web/tests/audio_suspended_queue.test.mjs runtime/web/tests/audio_voice_contract.test.mjs
rows.expected_evidence: Suspended audio queues are bounded and stopped voice slots can be reused.

rows.command: node --test runtime/web/tests/storage_contract.test.mjs
rows.expected_evidence: Storage persists values by scope/key, isolates projects, falls back on denied storage, and treats separator-bearing keys as opaque scoped values.

rows.command: node --test runtime/web/tests/network_mailbox_contract.test.mjs
rows.expected_evidence: Checkpoint bounds, credential isolation, queue limits, and WebSocket send/poll behavior execute under deterministic adapters.

rows.command: python tools/cargo_cache.py run -- cargo test -p stasis --test desktop_input_frame_seam -- --test-threads=1
rows.expected_evidence: Desktop input, frame, and generation seams preserve the runtime ordering contract.

rows.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File mobile/android/test_emulator.ps1 -Headless
rows.expected_evidence: Workshop emulator launch and asset/frame acceptance receipts are produced.

rows.command: python tools/cargo_cache.py run -- cargo test -p stasis --test generated_mobile_aot_runtime_seam -- --test-threads=1
rows.expected_evidence: Generated AOT bindings and mobile lifecycle order agree with the native runtime.

rows.command: node --test runtime/web/tests/*.test.mjs
rows.expected_evidence: The browser runtime package executes its host seams under deterministic Node adapters.

rows.command: python tools/ci/check_android_release_package.py --help
rows.expected_evidence: Package manifest checker exposes the required package/ABI/asset validation entrypoint.

rows.command: python tools/cargo_cache.py run -- cargo test -p stasis_runner --test shared_characterization_fixtures -- --test-threads=1
rows.expected_evidence: Rust deserializes the shared request/response fixtures and applies semantic request validation separately from JSON shape parsing.

rows.command: python tools/cargo_cache.py run -- cargo test -p stasis_lsp --lib -- --test-threads=1
rows.expected_evidence: LSP live-process requests retain protocol identity and diagnostic semantics.

rows.command: npm --prefix vscode-stasis test
rows.expected_evidence: TypeScript consumes shared response fixtures and agrees on shape-valid versus malformed cases.

rows.command: npm --prefix vscode-stasis run test:e2e
rows.expected_evidence: Installed VSIX launches the packaged toolchain and completes the extension-host workflow.

rows.command: bash tools/ci/build_ios_package.sh
rows.expected_evidence: Packaging/link evidence is produced; simulator/device runtime behavior is intentionally not claimed by this lane.

rows.command: python -m unittest tools.ci.test_run_architecture_characterization
rows.expected_evidence: Manifest schema, path confinement, unique IDs, evidence labels, and lane labels are validated.
